# Third-party components and experiment archives

`paper_runtime/` contains the dependencies of the released TalkNet-based runtime. See `../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for component notices.

Historical baseline sources and analyses are archived on the research server under `/mnt/nas/sdd1/mino/BYD/AVSR/releases/paper_20261026/archive`. The frozen 12-method comparison results remain under `/mnt/nas/sdd1/mino/BYD/AVSR/model_evaluations/comparison_4s1s_20261025`. These server archives are not dependencies of the released model.

Download model weights from [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/playwithmino/SAV-BandNet) and the paper dataset from [SAVE](https://huggingface.co/datasets/playwithmino/SAVE). Large checkpoints, caches and outputs are excluded from Git.
